Installation

PyPI

Currently installation from PyPI is not supported.

Conda

This does not actually work, it is placeholder text.

Due to the usage of graph-tool as a dependency, the installation of HiCONA in a dedicated environment is highly incentivised. Via Conda, create a new environment, and activate it, by running:

conda create -n HiCONA
conda activate HiCONA

Currently, due to some compatibility issues, it is required to manually install Cooler and graph-tool in this order (despite graph-tool documentation suggesting to install graph-tool first):

conda install -c conda-forge -c bioconda cooler
conda install -c conda-forge graph-tool

Then one can finally install HiCONA:

conda install -c conda-forge hicona

In the future the whole procedure will be streamlined.
